dailyBrief: In a landmark debut, Anthropic's valuation soared to $2 trillion on the Nasdaq, signaling strong investor confidence in AI's future potential. Meanwhile, their AI model, Claude, has made significant strides by addressing two unresolved issues in black hole physics, showcasing the technology's far-reaching implications beyond traditional business applications. On the labor front, DeepMind employees are moving to unionize, reflecting growing concerns over workplace conditions in the tech industry. Additionally, the launch of Onlook, an open-source developer tool for designers from Y Combinator's Winter 2025 cohort, highlights the increasing intersection of AI and design. However, OpenAI continues to grapple with a persistent WebRTC problem, which may impact its real-time communication capabilities and user experience.
